comments.content: Replacing `inTest` from `@n8n/backend-common` with `process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test'` changes behavior. `inTest` typically also accounts for `N8N_ENV`/`VITEST`/`JEST_WORKER_ID` and other test-runner signals, so migrations may now log during tests when they previously didn't (or vice versa). Consider keeping `inTest` or replicating its full logic to avoid noisy logs / behavior drift.

`getApiKeyScopesForRole` was previously imported from `@/public-api/permissions.ee` and is now imported from `@n8n/permissions`. Please verify the two implementations are equivalent — if the EE version had additional scopes or role handling, this migration will produce different results for existing API keys.

The `@ts-expect-error Tech debt` annotations were added to silence type errors on the `map` callbacks. Since these are inside a migration that runs against real data, please confirm the runtime shape of `usersWithApiKeys` / `oldestApiKeysPerUser` matches the annotated types — otherwise the migration may silently insert/update with undefined values.

The file-level `/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/ban-ts-comment */` was added but no `@ts-ignore`/`@ts-expect-error` appears in the visible diff. If it's no longer needed, remove it; if it is needed, prefer a scoped disable over a file-level one.
`down?: MigrationFn | never` is redundant (`never` is absorbed by any union). The added eslint-disable masks this. Consider simplifying to `down?: MigrationFn`.

`interface Migration extends Function` with an eslint-disable for `ban-types` is a code smell. Consider typing this as `new (...args: unknown[]) => ReversibleMigration | IrreversibleMigration` or a constructor type instead of `Function`.
`p-lazy` is added as a dependency but does not appear to be used in the diff. If it's not needed by the moved migrations, drop it to avoid an unnecessary dependency.
